config.decision_rule: Unit = one world (paired across planners). An arm "beats" a baseline on a metric iff the lower bound of the 95 % paired percentile-bootstrap CI (4000 resamples) of the benefit is > 0. The arm selected as PRODUCTION is the one with the highest mean hidden_state_error_improvement among arms that beat fixed, random and coverage; if no arm beats all three, the highest mean is still reported and the honest conclusion is recorded instead of a selection.
